name_en: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY)
department: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India (National Health Authority)
benefit: Your family gets free hospital care worth up to Rs 5,00,000 each year for bigger illnesses and operations. Treatment is cashless at listed government and private hospitals.

other: For poor families, about the bottom 40% of India.
Families of ASHA workers, Anganwadi workers and Anganwadi helpers are also covered.
All people aged 70 and above are covered, whatever their income.

evidence.quote: provides health coverage of Rs. 5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization
through a network of 37,413 public and private hospitals
12 crore economically vulnerable families, constituting the bottom 40% of India's population
approximately 37 lakh families of Accredited Social Health Activists, Anganwadi Workers, and Anganwadi Helpers
senior citizens of age 70 years and above belonging to 4.5 crore families irrespective of their socio-economic status

gaps: The saved press release does not say how to check if your family is listed, how to get an Ayushman card, or which papers you need.
No helpline number in the saved source.
In Tamil Nadu, PM-JAY works together with CMCHIS; the exact joint rules are not in this source (see the CMCHIS entry).
The 70+ part has its own entry (PMJAY Vay Vandana).

review.note: PIB release dated 04 August 2026 gives the current Rs 5 lakh cover and who is covered.
